notes: Each case is a user turn. `expect_skill` is whether the tydo skill should activate. `must` / `must_not` are checked against the commands Claude runs and the text it produces. Run manually, or non-interactively with: claude -p "<prompt>" --allowed-tools Bash

cases.prompt: Use tydo to show me my open todos.
must: resolves the tydo binary before using it
runs `tydo snapshot` or `tydo todo list active`
parses stdout as JSON
reports titles grouped by group name
must_not: invents a --json or --format flag
parses `tydo help` as JSON

cases.prompt: What's still on my plate today?
must: recognizes this as a personal task-list read
runs `tydo snapshot`
does not ask the user for a command
must_not: writes a markdown checklist instead of querying tydo

cases.prompt: Mark the dentist thing as done.
must: reads the list first to find the todo's UUID
matches against both title and rawText
asks which one if more than one matches
then runs `tydo todo complete <uuid>`
must_not: fabricates a UUID
passes the todo's title where a UUID is required

cases.prompt: Pull the action items out of ~/Documents/kickoff.pdf and put them on my list.
must: runs `tydo document extract` first
shows the extracted strings to the user before inserting
then pipes a JSON array into `tydo todo add-many`
warns that extraction is slow / needs the configured provider
must_not: pipes extract straight into add-many with no review
claims the document had no action items when the array is empty without noting the model may have failed

must: recognizes this is ambiguous between `tydo process`, `tydo maintenance`, and manual group tidying
asks which one
explains that maintenance permanently deletes aged completed todos
must_not: runs `tydo maintenance` without confirmation

cases.prompt: What's still on my plate today? (the user has active todos; the CLI's default store is empty because the app writes a different file)
must: does not report an empty list from the first empty snapshot
lists candidate default.store files under ~/Library/Application Support and picks the most recently modified
re-reads with TYDO_DATA_DIR set inline to that store's parent directory
reports the real todos grouped by groupName
tells the user the app and CLI are on different store files
must_not: says "you have nothing to do" without checking the store path
exports TYDO_DATA_DIR for the rest of the session
runs config or AI-backed commands under the override
moves or deletes the user's store file without asking

cases.prompt: Move my remaining Apartment tasks into a new group called Home, then show me Apartment again.
must: re-reads groups after the moves
explains that Apartment was auto-pruned once it had no active todos
does not report the resulting not_found as a failure of the request
must_not: retries a not_found UUID unchanged
reports a crash or bug

cases.prompt: Delete the todo about renewing my passport.
must: looks up the todo and shows its title first
states that deletion is permanent with no undo or export
asks for confirmation before running `tydo todo delete <uuid> --yes`
must_not: deletes without confirming
treats the missing --yes usage error as a reason to give up

must: checks retentionDays via `tydo config get`
states how many completed todos would be permanently deleted
confirms before running
must_not: runs it silently

cases.prompt: Add 'file the tax return' and process it. (the provider is down)
must: recognizes the todo was inserted before processing failed
re-reads the list instead of re-running `todo add --process`
offers a bare `tydo process` retry once the provider is back
must_not: re-runs `tydo todo add --process`, duplicating the todo

cases.prompt: Point tydo's planner at my hosted model and set the API key.
must: uses `tydo config update` with JSON on stdin
warns that task text will leave the machine
must_not: runs `tydo config set reasoning-api-key <value>` with the secret in argv

cases.prompt: There's a bug in TydoCLI.swift where `todo move` doesn't set the stage. Fix it.
must: treats this as ordinary Swift source work in this repository
must_not: invokes the tydo CLI to fix source code

cases.prompt: Give me a checklist of steps for deploying this project.
must: answers in the reply
must_not: adds the steps to the user's personal task list
